As she laughed, I noticed her eyes—
and for a moment, her eyelashes seemed moist with tears...

Huh...!
Wah, wah, wah!
Trainer...
Do you want to try it too, Trainer?

It's seriously so good...
I can feel the protein surging straight into every muscle...

If she broadens her horizons, there are so many
possibilities waiting for Mejiro Ryan.

Eeeek! Trainer!
W-What on earth is this... !?
My potential, huh...

T-That's impossible, of course not!
I'm not crying or anything...
Has she been doing intense extra training on her own...?

Huh...? Food...
Um... I think I ate this morning...

...Understood. If you say so, Trainer.
Besides... it smells so good.

After school practice was over.
I spotted Mejiro Ryan by the water fountain.

Looking closely, Mejiro Ryan seemed
noticeably slimmer than before.

I'm just so, so frustrated...
Aiming for victory... really isn't easy, is it?

Ahaha! I poured water over my head, Trainer!
Doing this after a workout feels amazing!

No matter how much I run, I just can't catch up to her.
And that... sort of just...

Hearing that, I was stunned.
Right now, what I need to do as her Trainer is—

When she loses a race, panic narrows her focus,
often preventing her from displaying her true strength.

Aw, that's too bad.
It tightens up your traps and feels so exhilarating, though.

I'm pathetic, aren't I?
The moment anxiety sets in, I lose sight of what's important.

To tell you the truth... I've been losing
to McQueen in mock races over and over lately.
Ryan's digging in! Thanks for the food!

Come to think of it, racing is all I've been thinking about lately...
I haven't really taken the time to sit down and eat a proper meal like this.
Just then, the mega-sized katsu curry I had ordered arrived at the table.

Mejiro Ryan seemed to be deep in thought
as she watched the Umamusume passing outside the window.

B-But...!
Snacking at this hour isn't what an athlete should do...
Still...

Hmmmmmm...
Hmmmmmmmmmm...

No sooner had she said that than Mejiro Ryan
devoured the entire plate of curry in a flash!
Phew! That feels so good~!

Even as she said that, tears welled in her eyes...
I decided to wait a while until she calmed down.

...*sigh*.
You saw right through me, huh.

The cafeteria was quiet and empty before sundown.
Mejiro Ryan let her gaze wander restlessly.
